summary: A room or group of rooms for gatherings of people who do not know the building: conference, lectures, theatre-style seating, banquets, standing events. Swedish law classifies it by fire class (BFS 2024:7: Vk 2A up to 150 persons, 2B above 150, 2C above 150 with alcohol served beyond a limited extent, Vk 0 above 1,200, or above 600 with alcohol) and requires a hearing-aid system in samlingssalar (BFS 2024:12 3 kap. 6 §). The occupant number, not the floor area, drives egress widths, WC count, ventilation and alarms. No Swedish law sets m2 per seat. The only legal density is the BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 4 § default of 2.5 persons/m2 for a samlingslokal when the real maximum is unknown.

regulatory.bbr_verksamhetsklass: 2A (max 150 persons), 2B (more than 150), 2C (more than 150 with alcohol served beyond a limited extent); Vk 0 above 1,200 unfamiliar persons or above 600 with alcohol (designed by fire analysis). BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 9, 11–13 §§. See cross_cutting.json fire_vk_0 and fire_vk_2abc. Do not duplicate those rules here.

key_laws.ref: BFS 2024:7 Boverkets föreskrifter och allmänna råd om säkerhet i händelse av brand i byggnader: 2 kap. 4 §, 11–13 §§; 7 kap. 9, 19–21, 27–29, 39–46 §§
BFS 2024:12 Boverkets föreskrifter om byggnaders tillgänglighet och användbarhet: 2 kap. 6–7 §§, 3 kap. 6–7 §§, 4 kap. 1–3 §§
BFS 2024:10 Boverkets föreskrifter om skydd mot buller i byggnader: 2 kap. 2 § tabell 2:1, 5 § tabell 2:4, 9 §
Förordning (1998:899) om miljöfarlig verksamhet och hälsoskydd, 35 § (sufficient toilets)
Folkhälsomyndighetens allmänna råd om höga ljudnivåer (FoHMFS 2014:15)

permits: Bygglov for change of use (PBL 9 kap. 2 § första stycket 3 a) when converting from office. The detaljplan must allow the use. 'Centrum (C)' typically covers samlingslokaler, but check the plan wording (indicative, not verified against Boverket's planbestämmelser guide).

Public events (offentlig tillställning) may need a Police permit under Ordningslagen (1993:1617) 2 kap. The Police can set a maximum number of persons (sourced from general knowledge, not re-checked).

Alcohol service needs a serveringstillstånd from the municipality (Alkohollagen 2010:1622, 8 kap.). Alcohol beyond a limited extent with more than 150 persons moves the room to Vk 2C (15 m travel distance).
Posted sign with the design occupant number is required in 2B/2C (BFS 2024:7 7 kap. 41 §).
regulatory.operator_oversight: Kommunens byggnadsnämnd (bygglov, slutbesked); räddningstjänsten (LSO 2003:778 tillsyn); Polisen (offentlig tillställning); kommunens miljö- och hälsoskyddsnämnd (noise, toilets under FMH); kommunens alkoholhandläggare (serveringstillstånd)

gross_m2_per_unit.source: No Swedish law, guidance or public programme found that gives gross m2 per visitor for a whole venue (hall + foyer + WC + back-of-house). Use the hall density below and derive the support spaces.

egress_design_density.source: BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 4 §: the design number is the maximum number expected; if not known, samlingslokal = 2.5 persons/m2 (affärslokal 0.5, pub/bar 3). Verified against the lagen.nu rendering of BFS 2024:7.

layout_densities_persons_per_m2_net.source: Repealed BBR general advice (BBR 5:333 tabell 5:333, BFS 2011:26; consolidated BBR p. 52). No longer in force for new applications after 30 Jun 2026; restaurant/conference figures allowed deduction of loose furniture. Labelled 'repealed BBR general advice, practice'.
layout_densities_persons_per_m2_net.note: Fire-design maxima, not comfort layouts. Inverted: 0.40 m2/person standing, 0.59 m2/person seated in rows, 1.0 m2/person banquet, 1.43 m2/person conference. The 0.8/0.6/1.6/2.0 m2 figures in data/standards/space_requirements.json (event_venue) are unsourced working values.

occupancy.hourly_presence_note: Modelling assumption (indicative, not sourced). Mixed profile: daytime conference use at about 30 % of capacity, evening events peaking at 80 %. Annual utilisation of event halls is typically low and intermittent, and many days have zero use.

required.basis: Defining space of the use. Its occupant number sets the fire class (BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 11–13 §§) and egress (7 kap.). BFS 2024:12 3 kap. 6 §: samlingssalar shall have a system for sound transfer to hearing aids (teleslinga/IR or equivalent), and the sound environment shall give good audibility and speech intelligibility.

size.count: design occupants. 0.4 m2/person is the legal default density (2.5 p/m2); 0.59 seated rows, 1.0 banquet and 1.43 conference come from the repealed BBR table (practice).
size.source: BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 4 § (default 2.5 persons/m2 for samlingslokal); repealed BBR tabell 5:333 for layout variants.

spaces.shareable_note: Typical time-sharing: office or coworking conference by day, events in the evening, community use at weekends. The fire design must cover the highest-occupancy mode (e.g. standing event), not the daytime mode.
spaces.notes: Ceiling height: BFS 2024:8 5 kap. 1 § is now functional only. 2,700 mm is the AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 5 § allmänna råd for rooms for many persons (workplace guidance) and the repealed BBR 3:3112 value for publika lokaler (p. 26), so it is guidance, not law. Egress (law, BFS 2024:7 7 kap.): two exit doors up to 600 persons, three up to 1,000, four above (9 §); doors at least 0.80 m clear up to 150 persons and 1.15 m above (27 §); passages 0.90/1.20 m (28 §); total door width at least 1.00 m per 150 persons, and 1.00 m per 300 with one door blocked (29 §). In 2B/2C one alternative exit must lead to the main entrance or equivalent (7 kap. 17 §). Reverberation: the repealed BBR 3:1451 allmänt råd gave 0.8 s for samlingssalar, and up to 2.0 s in rooms higher than 3.5 m (indicative now). Accessibility: BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 6 § says not all audience places need to be accessible. The new text does not mention stages. The repealed BBR 3:1452 said podia and stages shall always be accessible, and the general requirement of BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 2 § (accessible communication spaces, lift above 1 m level difference) still applies (see cross_cutting access_public_premises_other). Loads: C1 movable seats 2.5, C2 fixed seats 2.5, C3 3.0, C5 large crowds 5.0 kN/m2 (BFS 2024:6 tabell 4:1). An office slab (B, 2.5) suits seated use only. Standing events and concerts (C5) and dancing (C4, dynamic: 4 kap. 13 §) exceed it.

required.basis: Function follows from egress: in 2B/2C the alternative exit leads to the main entrance or equivalent (BFS 2024:7 7 kap. 17 §), and the main entrance must be accessible (BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 1 §). If the foyer has a reception, it needs a hearing-aid system (BFS 2024:12 3 kap. 6 §). No size requirement.

size.source: No Swedish source sets foyer m2 per person. The 0.35 m2/person in space_requirements.json is an unsourced working value.

spaces.shareable_note: A shared building lobby can serve as the foyer if it carries the egress and the queuing load. See shared_amenities.shared_lobby.
spaces.notes: In conversions the foyer often doubles as an escape route, so furniture, bars and cloakroom queues must not reduce the 1.20 m passage width (BFS 2024:7 7 kap. 28 §).

required.basis: Not required by law. Typical for events and conferences in the Nordic climate.

spaces.notes: Fire load from coats; keep queues out of escape routes.

required.basis: FMH (1998:899) 35 §: there shall be sufficient toilets in or next to buildings where people stay. BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 7 §: if there are public toilets in a publik lokal, at least one shall be accessible, with room to turn a wheelchair and side transfer on both sides. See cross_cutting.json access_public_premises_wc and san_public.

size.count: No Swedish ratio of WCs per visitor found. Working value from data/standards/space_requirements.json: 3 WC per 100 persons (unsourced, indicative only).
size.source: FMH 35 § says only 'tillräckligt'. Lawline and municipal practice point to the municipal miljöförvaltning for event-specific requirements. AFS 2023:12's 1 WC per started 15 employees covers staff only.

spaces.shareable_note: Peak demand is at intermissions. Shared WCs must be reachable without passing locked areas when other tenants are closed.
spaces.notes: Peak sanitary load far exceeds office stacks. Office cores usually provide WCs for about 1 per 15 staff, so a 300-person event floor may need several times the core's WC count and new drainage. Accessible WC size: BFS 2024:12 is functional (1.5 m turning circle per 1 kap. 6 §, side transfer on both sides). The 2.2 x 2.2 m figure is AFS 2023:12 allmänna råd and the repealed BBR 3:1453 advice (guidance).

required.basis: Needed for any reconfigurable hall (theatre, banquet and standing modes). Not regulated.

size.count: derived from stacked furniture volume for the largest layout
size.source: No Swedish source. The 0.15 x hall factor for back-of-house in space_requirements.json is unsourced.

spaces.shareable_note: Adjacent at the same level as the hall, with a level route and wide doors.
spaces.notes: Storage loads: E1 5.0 kN/m2 (BFS 2024:6 tabell 4:1), double the office value of 2.5. Locate stores on stronger bays or at grade.

required.basis: Needed for the banquet variant. Food handling requires registration of the food business with the municipality (EU Regulation 852/2004 art. 6 via Swedish livsmedelslagstiftning; indicative, not re-checked). Alcohol requires serveringstillstånd (Alkohollagen 8 kap.) and moves rooms above 150 persons to Vk 2C.

spaces.shareable_note: Can be the building's café or restaurant kitchen. See shared_amenities.shared_kitchen.
spaces.notes: Kitchen exhaust and grease ducts are hard to route through office floors. Cooled waste for food waste was recommended in the repealed BBR 3:422 allmänt råd.

spaces.label_en: AV / control room, stage and back-of-house

required.basis: The hearing-aid sound transfer system is required in samlingssalar (BFS 2024:12 3 kap. 6 §). Stage accessibility was explicit in the repealed BBR 3:1452 ('podier och scener ska dock alltid vara tillgängliga') but is not named in BFS 2024:12. The general accessibility rules still apply. Control room and dressing rooms are practice.

spaces.notes: Amplified music: FoHMFS 2014:15 allmänna råd recommend at most LAeq 100 dB and LAFmax 115 dB where children under 13 are not admitted, and 97/110 dB where they are (values from secondary sources, confidence sourced). Sound insulation to neighbouring dwellings: BFS 2024:10 tabell 2:1 requires DnT,w,50 at least 56 dB and tabell 2:4 requires L'nT,w,50 at most 52 dB from lokaler to dwellings. These are building minima and are often insufficient for amplified music (engineering judgement, indicative).

required.basis: AFS 2023:12 staff facilities apply to employees. See cross_cutting.json staff_facilities (not duplicated here).

spaces.shareable_note: Small venues often share staff rooms with the building operator.

variants.label: Seated theatre / lecture (rows)
variants.changes: Densest seated layout: 1.7 p/m2 without fixed chairs (repealed BBR advice, practice), or the seat count with fixed seating. C1/C2 floor load 2.5 kN/m2 matches office slabs. Sightlines and raked floors favour double-height or ground-floor space. Accessible seats should be integrated (repealed BBR 3:1452 allmänt råd).

variants.label: Banquet / dinner
variants.changes: About 1.0 p/m2 (repealed BBR 'restaurang' advice, practice). Needs a serving kitchen and bar. Alcohol beyond a limited extent with more than 150 persons gives Vk 2C (15 m travel distance, spoken evacuation alarm, BFS 2024:7 7 kap. 19, 44 §§).

variants.label: Standing event / concert / reception
variants.changes: 2.5 p/m2 legal default (BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 4 §). Highest egress, WC and ventilation demand. Floor category C5 (5.0 kN/m2) for crowds, C4 (4.0) for dancing, with dynamic checks (BFS 2024:6 4 kap. 13 §). Usually the binding mode in an office building.

variants.label: Conference / seminar rooms
variants.changes: 0.7 p/m2 (repealed BBR 'konferensrum' advice, practice). Up to 150 persons is Vk 2A. Fits office floors best. Hearing-aid system is required if the room is a samlingssal (the repealed advice gave 'at least 50 persons' as an example).

typical_blockers: Egress: office floors are Vk 1 with 45 m travel; an assembly use needs 30 m (2A/2B) or 15 m (2C), plus exit widths of 1.0 m per 150 persons. A standing event of 300 persons needs at least 2 m of total door width and two independent exits at least 5 m apart (BFS 2024:7 7 kap. 9, 19, 29 §§).
Fire alarm, evacuation alarm, emergency lighting and occupant sign are required in 2B/2C (cross_cutting fire_vk_2abc).
Floor loads: office slabs are designed for B = 2.5 kN/m2. Standing and crowd use (C5, 5.0) and dancing (C4, 4.0, dynamic) exceed this (BFS 2024:6 tabell 4:1).
Columns on a 6–8 m office grid obstruct sightlines and divisible-hall layouts.
Ceiling height: office floors often have 2.6–2.7 m under suspended ceilings. A large hall wants more for volume, acoustics and air distribution (no legal minimum; 2.7 m is guidance).
Ventilation capacity: assembly density is 10–25 times office density. Office AHUs are sized for about 0.1 persons/m2.
WC and drainage capacity at intermission peaks.
Impact and airborne sound to dwellings or offices above (BFS 2024:10 tables 2:1 and 2:4 where dwellings adjoin).
typical_enablers: Ground floor with direct exits to open air (no stair dependence) and an existing double-height entrance hall.
Seated conference variant up to 150 persons (Vk 2A, C1 load 2.5 kN/m2) fits typical office slabs.
Sprinkler lets travel distances grow by one third (BFS 2024:7 7 kap. 21 §).
Shared lobby and WC cores with other tenants (time-shared peaks).

open_questions: No Swedish ratio of visitor WCs per person was found (FMH 35 § says only 'sufficient'). Decide whether to adopt a foreign standard as practice (e.g. a Nordic event guideline) or keep the unsourced 3 per 100 working value.
Ordningslagen and Alkohollagen paragraph numbers for permits were not re-checked against the statute text.
Confirm whether Boverket's new vägledning to BFS 2024:7 gives any replacement density table for layouts (the old tabell 5:333 is repealed).
FoHMFS 2014:15 values were taken from municipal summaries; verify against the PDF.
Detaljplan use category (C vs R vs other) for samlingslokaler was not verified against Boverket's planbestämmelser guidance.
